name: peerkit-video-chat
description: Showcase video chat application built on PeerKit
comment:overrides: Pin React Native + React to the Expo SDK 56 versions tree-wide. The mobile native modules (react-native-webrtc/permissions) and the published RN transport accept a range of RN via broad peer ranges, so npm would otherwise hoist a react-native that mismatches the Expo 56 / expo-dev-client codegen, breaking the metro bundle.
comment:overrides-vite: Pin vite to a single 7.3.x copy. vitest ^4 (root) now resolves vite 8, while desktop targets vite 7; the two physical copies stop @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte from hooking into electron-vite's bundler, silently breaking .svelte transformation. Pinning dedupes to one vite 7 instance.
